description: This file defines TypeScript types, constants, and functions related to the BlueBubbles plugin, including configuration types, URL utilities, and a fetch wrapper with timeout and SSRF protection.

methods.name: normalizeBlueBubblesServerUrl
methods.description: Normalizes a server URL by trimming, adding scheme if missing, and removing trailing slashes.

methods.name: buildBlueBubblesApiUrl
methods.description: Constructs a full API URL with optional password parameter.

methods.name: _setFetchGuardForTesting
methods.description: Replaces the fetch guard function for testing purposes.

methods.name: blueBubblesFetchWithTimeout
methods.description: Performs a fetch with timeout and optional SSRF policy, buffering response body as needed.
